column1: # Sassembly register names — GENERATED by tools/gen-registers.py.
# The NAMES come from doc 02 §2.4 and are a human decision — the one
# input here that cannot be derived. The NUMBERS are read back out of
# the assembler: each ABI name is placed in rd and the field extracted,
# using the bit map B-038 derived. t0-t6 are x5-x7 and x28-x31, s0-s11
# are x8, x9 and x18-x27 — split ranges, and exactly what a person gets
# wrong from memory. Getting one wrong emits a valid instruction on the
# wrong register: no error, wrong program.
